tools: node tools/ground-metrics.cjs <png>  (the lowest third of a 1920x1080 picture)
node tools/joint-rows.cjs --joint=0.9,5.4 --out=joint-rows.json  (joint width on the screen, row by row, from the page's own ground hits)

joint_on_screen_1080p.note: mean width in pixels of a joint of the given width over the rows where the paving shows down the middle column; rows 720-1062 of 1080 (the lowest third) in both views; the paving begins at about row 700, so the middle third (360-720) holds one sampled row. Same geometry for both widths (art3's new pose: eye 0.81 m, fov 44; cam06: eye 1.32 m, fov 52).
joint_on_screen_1080p.correction: an earlier version of this note and of the PR body gave 1.64 px (art3) and 2.38 px (cam06) from a formula that assumed the eye's height and the pitch's sign; those were wrong, these come from the page
